title: Alphabet Inc.’s (GOOG) Google Offers Spam Policy Changes to Avert EU Antitrust Fine, Reuters Reports
title_zh: 据路透社报道，Alphabet Inc. (GOOG) 旗下谷歌提出垃圾邮件政策变更，以避免欧盟反垄断罚款
summary: Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOG) is one of the top “blue chip” stocks that were suddenly on fire in April.
summary_zh: Alphabet Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOG）是四月份突然火爆的顶级“蓝筹”股之一。

title: Jack Daniel’s Maker Turns Down Rival’s Takeover Bid
title_zh: 杰克丹尼的制造商拒绝了竞争对手的收购要约
summary: Jack Daniel’s maker Brown-Forman rejected a roughly $15 billion takeover offer from rival Sazerac, according to people familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，Jack Daniel 的制造商 Brown-Forman 拒绝了竞争对手 Sazerac 提出的约 150 亿美元的收购要约。

title: Jack Daniel’s Maker Brown-Forman Rejects $15 Billion Takeover Offer From Sazerac
title_zh: Jack Daniel 的制造商 Brown-Forman 拒绝 Sazerac 150 亿美元的收购要约
summary: Advisers for Brown-Forman informed Sazerac on Monday that the company was rejecting the $32-a-share cash offer.
summary_zh: Brown-Forman 的顾问周一告知 Sazerac，该公司拒绝每股 32 美元的现金收购要约。

title: Microsoft secures structural wins in OpenAI revenue cap deal, Wedbush says
title_zh: Wedbush 表示，微软在 OpenAI 收入上限协议中获得了结构性胜利
summary: OpenAI has agreed to cap the total revenue it shares with Microsoft Corp (NASDAQ:MSFT) at $38 billion through 2030, down sharply from a prior arrangement that could have generated as much as $135 billion in cumulative payments for the software giant, according to people famili...
summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，OpenAI 已同意将其与微软公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MSFT）分享的总收入上限限制在 2030 年之前的 380 亿美元，这比之前的安排大幅下降，此前的安排可能为这家软件巨头带来高达 1350 亿美元的累计付款。
